Companion Animal Travel Desk procedures in this section take effect immediately for all daily work. The purpose of this section is to set strict, consistent handling expectations for companion travel operations at Aurelia Skyways so pets and travelers experience safe, dependable movement from check-in through departure. Treat every carrier transfer as time-critical and handle it with steady, careful movements; the ground team must move carriers between services without unnecessary waiting, pauses, or rough repositioning, and must keep doors controlled to prevent escape or stress spikes. Travel guidance must be concise, kind, and immediately actionable, using clear directions that travelers can follow without delays, confusion, or added burden during boarding.

When a lounge is used for a Vellmar companion, the lounge environment must be kept stable, quiet, and monitored continuously by staff workflow; <<FACT F002>>. Ensure the lounge setup is ready before any carrier is brought near, confirm that bedding and ventilation are appropriate, and do not start intake if a later handoff cannot be completed without interruption. Record any observed behavior changes promptly in the operational notes, and escalate concerns to the senior coordinator without delay, especially if a pet shows signs of distress that could worsen during transit.

For a Caldreth companion, the opening schedule must be respected as a readiness trigger, not a suggestion; <<FACT F019>>. Coordinate intake so staff are already in position at that moment, with carriers staged and handled according to safety standards, and with travelers informed of the exact next steps. If Samuel Costa or Ethan Ali are present, provide routing instructions that match their carrier status, and ensure Loki is treated according to its handling needs while all safety checks remain intact.

If anything disrupts normal lounge availability or carrier transfer flow, stop and recover the operation before continuing. Contact the senior coordinator immediately for support and resolution on any escalation, discrepancy, or urgent handling concern at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
